title: migration-group.v1
description: One lineage group's triage (migration design, section 16): what the family is for, how it consolidates, its order, and which members are superseded. Drafted by plain code or a sandboxed model, confirmed by a Director. A member can't move past triaged until its group record is confirmed.

consolidation.description: merge: one repo. share-library: separate repos that share code. separate: unrelated in code.

order.description: Members in migration order. Superseded members are left out.

superseded.description: Members that go only to the archive.

confirmed_by.description: The Director's GitHub login. Null while a draft.
